name: Gluttony IF
divergenceSummary: Awakening in Pleiades Watchtower with complete amnesia, Subaru finds the Books of the Dead in Taygeta. Terrified of his comrades' expectations, he begins assassinating anyone who ever knew him to piece together his lost identity.
headline: Patchwork of the Dead
description: Awakening with complete amnesia, Subaru uses the Books of the Dead to kill anyone who ever knew him, desperately stitching together his lost identity.

events.name: The Clean Slate in the Augria Sands
events.description: Subaru loses every single memory of his life and companions, terrified by the expectant gazes of strangers treating him as a legendary savior.

events.name: Discovery of the Books of the Dead
events.description: Reading a book of a deceased person reveals their memories. Realizing this, Subaru decides that to know who he was, everyone who knows him must die.

events.name: The Patchwork of Slaughtered Memories
events.description: One by one, comrades are poisoned and murdered so Subaru can read their memoirs, resulting in a horrifying stitched personality that is neither past nor present Subaru.
